name: Shumard oak
desc: Shumard oak (Quercus shumardii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Quercus shumardii, the Shumard oak, spotted oak, Schneck oak, Shumard red oak, or swamp red oak, is one of the largest of the oak species in the red oak group.
